Only adjournment was voted.

what_happened.line: The board will oversee the public access cable committee through the town manager and program coordinator, since the committee has no quorum; appointments were not rescinded.
The board reviewed an open meeting law complaint against the cable committee, whose chair said it had operated with three members as a quorum on advice from the town.
The building reuse committee chair will poll members and return with a proposed charge centered on real estate and development of surplus buildings, plus any vacancies.
The board accepted a Green Communities certificate and grant check, which the task force chair presented.
The chair will discuss proposed cable committee bylaw changes, including an annual budget filing, with the town manager for the town meeting warrant. Only adjournment was voted.

why_it_matters: The cable committee's quorum problem moves its oversight to town staff, and proposed bylaw changes could come before voters at town meeting, including a yearly budget and financial statement from the committee.
A refocused building reuse committee points toward decisions on whether surplus town buildings are developed or sold, which bear on town property and the tax base.
watch_next: The building reuse committee's proposed new charge and any vacancies, to be returned to the board.
The cable committee bylaw changes as they appear on the town meeting warrant.
